actions: Locate oak trees in the current area.
Break 7 oak log blocks using your hand.
Collect all dropped oak logs until you have 7 in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 7 oak_log.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 1 oak_log into the crafting grid.
Craft 4 oak_planks from the 1 oak_log.
Take the 4 oak_planks from the crafting result.
Repeat the process of placing 1 oak_log into the crafting grid.
Craft another 4 oak_planks from the second oak_log.
Take the 4 oak_planks from the crafting result again.
Repeat once more by placing 1 oak_log into the crafting grid.
Craft the final 4 oak_planks from the last oak_log.
Take the 4 oak_planks from the crafting result one last time.
Verify that your inventory now contains a total of 12 oak_planks.
Open your crafting interface by right-clicking on the crafting grid or using a crafting table if available.
Place 4 oak planks into the 2x2 crafting grid.
Ensure that the oak planks are arranged in any configuration in the crafting grid.
Observe that a crafting table appears as the result of your crafting actions.
Drag the crafting table from the crafting result box into your inventory.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 crafting_table.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 2 oak planks into the crafting grid.
Craft 4 sticks from the oak planks.
Collect the 4 sticks from the crafting output.
Repeat steps 1 to 4 two more times to craft additional sticks.
After the second crafting, you will have a total of 8 sticks.
Craft one more time using 2 oak planks to create 4 more sticks.
Collect the last 4 sticks from the crafting output.
Add the newly crafted sticks to your inventory to ensure you have a total of 9 sticks.
Open your crafting table interface by right-clicking on the crafting table in your inventory.
Place 3 oak planks into the three slots of the crafting grid.
Place 2 sticks into the remaining two slots of the crafting grid.
Ensure that the crafting grid shows the wooden pickaxe as the resulting item.
Click on the wooden pickaxe in the crafting output to collect it into your inventory.
Find a location with stone blocks nearby.
Equip your wooden pickaxe from your inventory.
Approach a stone block within reach.
Mine the stone block using your wooden pickaxe.
Collect the cobblestone that drops from the mined stone block.
Repeat the mining process until you have mined 11 cobblestone in total.
Check your inventory to ensure you have exactly 11 cobblestone.
Open your inventory to check the items you currently have.
Verify that you have at least 3 cobblestone in your inventory.
Verify that you have at least 2 sticks in your inventory.
Ensure that the crafting_table is present in your inventory.
Place the crafting_table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 3 cobblestone in the first three slots of the first column.
Place 2 sticks in the middle and bottom slots of the second column of the crafting grid.
Observe that the stone_pickaxe appears in the result slot of the crafting interface.
Drag the stone_pickaxe from the result slot into your inventory.
Equip the wooden pickaxe from your inventory.
Locate a coal ore block in the nearby area.
Approach the coal ore block you have found.
Mine the coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Collect the coal that drops from the mined coal ore block.
Repeat the process by locating another coal ore block.
Mine the second coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Collect the coal that drops from the mined coal ore block.
Locate a third coal ore block in the vicinity.
Mine the third coal ore block using the wooden pickaxe.
Collect the coal that drops from the mined coal ore block.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 3 coal.
Open your inventory to confirm you have a crafting_table and 8 cobblestone.
Locate your crafting_table in your inventory.
Place the crafting_table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting interface, arrange 8 cobblestone blocks in all slots of the 3x3 crafting grid.
Observe that the furnace appears as a result in the crafting output slot.
Drag the furnace into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 1 furnace.
Locate an area where iron ore can be found, such as a cave or a mountainous region.
Equip the stone pickaxe from your inventory.
Mine the first iron ore block using the stone pickaxe.
Collect the dropped raw iron from the mined iron ore.
Repeat the process by mining another iron ore block to collect a second raw iron.
Continue mining iron ore blocks until you have mined a total of 7 iron ore blocks.
Ensure you have collected a total of 7 raw iron in your inventory by checking your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Locate the furnace in your inventory.
Place the furnace on the ground in a suitable location.
Open the furnace interface by right-clicking on it.
Place 1 raw iron into the top slot of the furnace.
Place 1 piece of coal into the bottom slot of the furnace to fuel it.
Wait for the smelting process to complete and collect the 1 iron ingot from the furnace.
Repeat steps 5 to 7 six more times, ensuring you smelt a total of 7 raw iron to obtain 7 iron ingots.
Open your inventory and verify that you have at least 3 iron ingots and 2 sticks.
Locate the crafting table in your inventory and select it.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 3 iron ingots in the top row.
In the crafting grid, place 1 stick in the center square.
In the crafting grid, place 1 stick in the bottom center square.
Observe that the iron pickaxe appears as a result in the crafting output.
Drag the iron pickaxe from the crafting output to your inventory.
Verify that you now have 1 iron pickaxe in your inventory.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Confirm that you have at least 3 iron ingots in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table in your current area.
Approach the crafting table.
Open the crafting interface at the crafting table.
Place 3 iron ingots into the crafting grid in a vertical column.
Verify that the crafting recipe for a bucket is displayed in the crafting output.
Take the crafted bucket from the crafting output and place it into your inventory.
Close the crafting interface.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 bucket.
Equip the iron pickaxe from your inventory.
Locate a cave or area where diamond ore is found, typically found deep underground, around Y level 2-16.
Mine 29 diamond ore blocks using the iron pickaxe.
Collect all the mined diamond ore until you have 29 diamond ore in your inventory.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 29 diamond ore.
Locate a gravel block in your current area.
Use your iron pickaxe to break the gravel block.
Collect the dropped items until you obtain 1 flint.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 1 flint.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Confirm that you have 1 bucket in your inventory.
Find a water source nearby, such as a river, lake, or ocean.
Approach the water source until you are standing next to it.
Select the bucket from your inventory.
Use the bucket to pour water from the water source, creating 1 water bucket.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 water bucket.
Verify that you have 3 diamonds in your inventory.
Confirm that you have 2 sticks in your inventory.
Ensure that you have a crafting table in your inventory.
Approach the crafting table.
Open the crafting interface of the crafting table.
Place 3 diamonds in the first three slots of the crafting grid.
Place 2 sticks in the middle and bottom slots of the crafting grid.
Confirm that the diamond pickaxe appears as a result in the crafting output.
Collect the diamond pickaxe from the crafting table.
Open your crafting table interface.
Locate the iron ingot in your inventory.
Drag the iron ingot into the crafting grid of the crafting table.
Locate the flint in your inventory.
Drag the flint into the crafting grid of the crafting table.
Verify that the crafting grid displays the flint_and_steel recipe.
Take the flint_and_steel from the crafting table output slot.
Close the crafting table interface.
Locate a lava pool in the current area.
Verify that you have a diamond pickaxe in your inventory.
Use the water bucket to place water next to the lava pool, ensuring it flows over the lava.
Wait for the lava to turn into obsidian as the water flows over it.
Equip the diamond pickaxe from your inventory.
Mine the obsidian block with the diamond pickaxe.
Collect the obsidian block into your inventory.
Repeat steps 3 to 7 until you have mined a total of 10 obsidian blocks.
Verify that your inventory contains exactly 10 obsidian blocks.
Ensure that you have 4 diamonds in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table in your inventory.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place 4 diamonds in the crafting grid in the shape of boots (two diamonds in the left column, two diamonds in the right column).
Verify that the crafting table shows the diamond boots as the resulting item.
Select the diamond boots from the crafting table output.
Move the diamond boots into your inventory.
Ensure that you have at least 7 diamonds in your inventory.
Open your crafting table interface.
Select the diamond leggings recipe in the crafting table.
Place 7 diamonds in the crafting grid according to the diamond leggings recipe.
Confirm the crafting action to create 1 diamond leggings.
Check your inventory to verify that you now have 1 diamond leggings.
Open your inventory to check the available items.
Verify that you have 8 diamonds in your inventory.
Locate the crafting table in your inventory.
Place the crafting table on the ground in your current location.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
Arrange the 8 diamonds in the crafting grid to form a diamond chestplate.
Confirm that the diamond chestplate appears in the result slot of the crafting interface.
Drag the diamond chestplate into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Open your inventory to confirm you have 5 diamonds available.
Approach the crafting table that you have in your inventory.
Right-click on the crafting table to open the crafting interface.
In the crafting grid, place 5 diamonds in the appropriate slots to craft a diamond helmet.
Confirm that the diamond helmet appears as a result in the crafting output slot.
Drag the diamond helmet from the crafting output slot into your inventory.
Verify that your inventory now contains 1 diamond helmet.
Verify that your inventory contains at least 2 diamonds and 1 stick.
Open your crafting table interface.
Place 2 diamonds in the crafting grid.
Place 1 stick in the crafting grid.
Ensure the crafting grid displays a diamond sword as the result.
Drag the diamond sword into your inventory to complete the crafting process.
Gather your obsidian blocks from your inventory, ensuring you have a total of 10.
Find a flat area in your world where you want to build the nether portal.
Place 4 obsidian blocks in a vertical line to form one side of the portal.
Place 4 more obsidian blocks in a vertical line to form the opposite side of the portal.
Connect the two sides by placing 3 obsidian blocks horizontally at the top.
Leave the center of the top open to complete the rectangular shape of the portal.
Verify that you have constructed a portal frame that is 4 blocks tall and 5 blocks wide, with an open space in the center.
Use your flint_and_steel from your inventory to ignite the inside of the portal frame.
Observe the purple portal that appears inside the frame, confirming the successful creation of your nether portal.
Locate the nearest nether portal in your area.
Approach the nether portal and ensure you have a diamond sword equipped.
Enter the nether portal to teleport to the Nether dimension.
Once in the Nether, look for a fortress where blazes spawn.
Navigate carefully through the fortress to find a blaze spawn point.
Engage a blaze by attacking it with your diamond sword.
Defeat the blaze to obtain a blaze rod.
Verify that your inventory now contains at least 1 blaze rod.
Take out 1 blaze_rod from your inventory.
Open the crafting table interface.
Place the 1 blaze_rod into the crafting grid.
Craft the blaze_powder using the blaze_rod.
Verify that your inventory now contains 2 blaze_powder.
Take 1 blaze_powder from your inventory for use.
Equip the diamond sword from your inventory.
Locate an area where endermen are commonly found, such as a flat, open space in the Overworld or near a desert at night.
Wait until nighttime or move to a location with low light to increase the chances of encountering endermen.
Spot an enderman in the vicinity.
Approach the enderman carefully to avoid angering it inadvertently.
Attack the enderman with your diamond sword.
Continue to attack the enderman until it is defeated.
Collect the ender pearl that drops from the defeated enderman.
Verify that your inventory now contains exactly 1 ender_pearl.
Open your inventory to view the items you currently have.
Confirm that you have 1 ender_pearl and 1 blaze_powder in your inventory.
Approach the crafting_table that you have placed in your current environment.
Right-click on the crafting_table to open the crafting interface.
Place 1 ender_pearl in the first slot of the crafting grid.
Place 1 blaze_powder in the second slot of the crafting grid.
Observe the resulting item in the crafting result slot, which should be an ender_eye.
Drag the ender_eye from the crafting result slot into your inventory.
Confirm that your inventory now contains 1 ender_eye.
